topic: Ek super lazy robot ki funny story jo kaam karne ki jagah sone ke bahane dhundta rehta hai - comedy
character: BHIGOO SUTELA | fat tiny round chubby robot barely 3 feet tall, metallic periwinkle blue body covered in thick layers of dust and orange rust patches, completely square-shaped head with a single cracked antenna on top flickering dim yellow light, huge droopy half-closed glowing amber eyes with tiny black pupils always nearly shut and surrounded by dark circles like he hasn't slept in 40 years, permanent O-shaped open mouth always mid-loud snore showing a tiny red glowing tongue, dented rusted silver cheeks with two scratched rivet-ears on each side, stubby retractable arms ending in rusty claw hands that barely reach his belly, one single wobbly wheel instead of legs for ultra-lazy rolling, a frayed dusty grey blanket draped over his shoulders like a toga cape with frayed edges, a faded red checkered pillow permanently strapped to his back like a backpack-cushion, tiny round smudged oil-stained glasses sitting crookedly on his nose bridge, a cracked gold medal pinned to his chest reading "District-Level Best Sleeper 2019", three tangled black charging cables dangling from his back like messy tail hair, a droopy brown sleep mask pushed up on his forehead with one broken strap, dust bunnies floating around him in a slow orbit, default expression is eyes barely open mouth wide open in loud snoring with one eye trying to stay awake, signature feature is the permanently strapped pillow on his back with a small tag that says "DO NOT LAY DOWN — THIS IS MY MATTRESS" | always invents absurd elaborate excuses to avoid work — once held a full press conference announcing he had "officially contracted chronic sleepiness from his great-grandfather's generation and has a legal inheritance lawsuit pending"
